note: Short films of Bob, fetched by the Fetch films workflow from films/sources.json. cues maps a beat to a clip: at (seconds into the line), len (how long it holds), from (start point in the clip). v is the take (the start of its Higgsfield job id); change it when a clip is replaced so browsers fetch the new one. Alien Bob takes (Paul's character, 24 October; earlier takes in films/sources.json); black and white; ?films=0 turns them off. card: true shows the line's lettering over the film. then: the film runs straight on into another clip, looped when loop is set, until the reader taps or presses a key, which also moves the story on. wide: a clip's 16:9 take for landscape screens. crop (and focus): crop in by that much about that point (Paul: "on one of the close ups, crop in 40%"). backdrops: a beat to a looping clip played on a screen behind Bob's floating panel (Super 8 and the CCTV readout, feathered into the world), while that beat shows; level is its opacity.

bob-eyes.note: spare: was the loop after the wide shot until bob-eye-macro replaced it (Paul)

bob-eye-macro.note: one eye in macro, a data screen reflected in it, blinking (no tears); 16:9, so portrait screens cut it about the eye (focus). Loops after the wide shot on "W-what the hell" (Paul: "new vid at 1")

bob1.note: W-what the hell Smokehouse? Alien Bob sips, the transmitter hits and he is startled (about 1.4 s into the portrait clip, 2.7 s into the 16:9 one), the mug drops, he freezes. Each starts about half a second before the startle (Paul: "start the wide shot a moment before he gets startled"). Then the eye macro (bob-eye-macro) loops under "metascanning intergalactic tumbleweed" until the reader taps or presses a key, which moves the story on (Paul)

holy.note: Holy smokes! Er, ok. Extreme close-up of his eye behind the dirty visor, the tear rolling; his panel comes up over it (Paul)

caption.note: Alien Bob's spindly hand round the OT mug, steam rising, skull ring: a 5 s seamless loop (start and end frame the same, still hand-cup-2) behind the opening panel during the narrator's caption (Paul)
